description: Records where the business gets its leads (keys from the setup guide list, for example thumbtack, google_lsa, yelp, website, other; other needs its words), as Get started's lead sources step does. An answer only: it opens and sends nothing. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.
